name: Thingery MCP
description: Reviews Thingery's write tools. Thingery is the open item database and MCP server for AI agents to list, find, and trade second-hand goods. Read tools keep Guard's usual handling; listings, images and the order path (ordering, payment, tracking, receipts, disputes, payout release) are gated on review because they publish public content or move money. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Start with the read tools search_items, get_item and describe_category; describe_category self-serves the category schema agents need before listing.
Keep create_listing, update_listing and add_item_image on Review: they publish or change public content under your account.
create_order charges the buyer and release_funds waives the dispute window to release the seller payout; confirm item, price and counterparty during review.
cancel_order on a paid order refunds the buyer through Stripe; treat every order mutation as a money action.
